name: Chthonic-Karst
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the east, towering mountain ranges. Nothing wears any of it smooth.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
There is money in iron here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
